video_title: AJ Dybantsa discusses NBA goals after being drafted number one overall by Wizards

quotes.speaker: AJ Dybantsa
quotes.summary_phrase: AJ Dybantsa on Wizards' playoff expectations and his career goals
quotes.excerpt: I just want to make the playoffs year one. I think we have the team to do it.

text_blocks.speaker: AJ Dybantsa
text_blocks.text: The Wizards haven't been to the playoffs in some time, so I just want to make the playoffs year one. I think we have the team to do it, getting AD, getting Trey Young and having our young core. But ultimate goal is I'll start getting D-Wade, I always wanted to be a Hall of Famer, but he says the goal I should have is to be a top 100 player. So I think 20 years from now, I answer the league 20 years from now, it will be the 100-year anniversary of the NBA. And you know, like top 75, they bring the 75 best players, I always says when they bring the 100 players out, that should be my goal instead of just being a Hall of Famer.

text_blocks.speaker: Ace Dybantsa
text_blocks.text: Sky is the limit. I mean it's sky is the limit.

quotes.speaker: AJ Dybantsa
quotes.summary_phrase: AJ Dybantsa shares message from Kevin Durant about his future
quotes.excerpt: He just said I'm a future DC legend.
quotes.quote: He just said I'm a future DC legend.
